notes: All binary values are lowercase hexadecimal. Fixed test keys: never use them elsewhere.
ed25519_reject: signatures that every engine must refuse (non-canonical S, small-order public key, truncated).

ed25519: seed (32 bytes) -> public_key; signature = detached Ed25519 signature of message (deterministic). rfc8032-* are the published vectors; event-envelope is the signed event of packages/crypto/test-vectors/envelope-v1.json (message = RFC 8785 canonical JSON without sig).
x25519: RFC 7748 section 6.1. shared = X25519(secret_a, public_b) = X25519(secret_b, public_a).

sealed_box: libsodium crypto_box_seal. sealed = ephemeral_pk || crypto_box_easy(message, nonce, recipient_pk, ephemeral_sk), nonce = BLAKE2b-192(ephemeral_pk || recipient_pk). Real seals use a random ephemeral key; these use a fixed one so that the output is reproducible.

aead: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (IETF), 24-byte nonce, ciphertext ends with the 16-byte tag. The two product-key-* cases come from packages/crypto/test-vectors/product-key-v1.json (key = crypto_kdf subkey of the test product key).

sha256: SHA-256 digest. kdf: crypto_kdf_derive_from_key(length, id, context, key). git_blob: object id of 'blob <size>\0<content>' (content is UTF-8 text), SHA-1 and SHA-256 repositories, written by git itself.
canonical_json: RFC 8785 (JCS). argon2id: crypto_pwhash with ALG_ARGON2ID13 (memlimit in bytes); optional on mobile.
cross: fixed test keys used by the cross-platform bundles (random outputs made on one platform and checked on another).
